faqs.question: How do I create an account on Inquisitors Society platform?
faqs.answer:
To create an account:
1. Go to the Sign Up page
2. Enter your Full Name, Email, and Phone Number
3. Select your role (Student, Teacher, Mentor, or Company)
4. For students: Enter your University, Department, and Year of Study
5. Create a strong password
6. Click 'Register'
7. Verify your email by clicking the link sent to your inbox
8. Complete your profile with additional details
followup: How do I verify my email?
What documents do I need?

faqs.question: How do I log in to my account?
faqs.answer:
To log in:
1. Go to the Login page
2. Enter your registered email address
3. Enter your password
4. Click 'Login'
5. You can also use Google or GitHub OAuth for quick login
6. Check 'Remember Me' to stay logged in
7. If you forgot your password, click 'Forgot Password'
followup: How do I reset my password?
Can I use Google to login?

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer:
To reset your password:
1. Go to the Login page
2. Click 'Forgot Password'
3. Enter your registered email address
4. You'll receive an OTP (One-Time Password) in your email
5. Enter the OTP in the verification field
6. Create a new password
7. Confirm your new password
8. Click 'Reset Password'
9. You can now log in with your new password
followup: I didn't receive the OTP email
What if I don't have access to my email?

faqs.question: How do I update my profile?
faqs.answer:
To update your profile:
1. Log in to your account
2. Click on your avatar in the top right corner
3. Select 'Profile' from the dropdown menu
4. Click 'Edit Profile'
5. Update your information (Bio, Skills, Interests, Social Links)
6. Upload a new profile picture (JPEG/PNG, max 1MB)
7. For students: Update academic information
8. For companies: Update company details
9. Click 'Save Changes'
10. Your profile will be updated immediately
followup: How do I upload my CV?
How do I add my skills?

faqs.question: How do I enroll in a course?
faqs.answer:
To enroll in a course:
1. Log in to your student account
2. Go to the 'Courses' section
3. Browse the course catalog
4. Use filters to find courses by category, level, or instructor
5. Click on a course to view details
6. Review the course description, learning objectives, and prerequisites
7. Click the 'Enroll' button
8. If the course is free: Enrollment is instant
9. If the course is paid: Complete the payment process
10. The course will appear in your dashboard
11. You can now start learning!
followup: What courses are free?
How do I track my progress?

faqs.question: How do I track my course progress?
faqs.answer:
To track your course progress:
1. Go to your Dashboard
2. Look for 'My Courses' section
3. Each course shows a progress bar with percentage
4. Click on a course to see detailed progress
5. The system automatically tracks:
   - Completed lessons
   - Quiz scores
   - Assignment submissions
   - Overall completion percentage
6. You'll see estimated time remaining to complete
7. Certificates are awarded upon 100% completion
8. Check your dashboard regularly for updates
followup: How do I get a certificate?
What if I'm stuck on a lesson?

faqs.question: How do I get a course completion certificate?
faqs.answer:
To get your certificate:
1. Complete all lessons in the course
2. Pass all quizzes with minimum 60% score
3. Submit all assignments
4. Maintain 80% attendance
5. Once all requirements are met, certificate is auto-generated
6. Go to your Dashboard > Certificates
7. Click 'Download' to get PDF version
8. Each certificate has a unique QR code for verification
9. Share your certificate on LinkedIn or social media
10. Employers can verify certificates using the QR code
followup: How do I verify a certificate?
What if I lose my certificate?

faqs.question: How do I verify a certificate?
faqs.answer:
To verify a certificate:
1. Locate the QR code on the certificate
2. Scan the QR code using any QR scanner app
3. Or visit our certificate verification page
4. Enter the unique verification code from the certificate
5. The system will show:
   - Student name
   - Course/Event/Internship name
   - Issue date
   - Expiry date (if applicable)
   - Status (Active/Revoked/Expired)
6. The certificate is verified if all details match
7. Forged certificates will fail verification
8. Contact support if you have issues
followup: My certificate isn't verifying
What if the QR code is damaged?

faqs.question: How do I apply for an internship?
faqs.answer:
To apply for an internship:
1. Log in to your student account
2. Go to the 'Internships' section
3. Browse available internships
4. Use filters by industry, duration, or stipend
5. Click on an internship to view details
6. Review requirements and responsibilities
7. Click 'Apply Now'
8. Upload your CV (required)
9. Optionally add a cover letter
10. Link your GitHub, LinkedIn, or Portfolio
11. Submit your application
12. Track application status in your dashboard
followup: How do I check my application status?
Can I apply to multiple internships?

faqs.question: How do I post an internship as a company?
faqs.answer:
To post an internship:
1. Register as a company on the platform
2. Complete your company profile
3. Go to your Company Dashboard
4. Click 'Post New Internship'
5. Enter internship details:
   - Title and Description
   - Requirements and Skills
   - Duration (4 weeks to 6 months)
   - Stipend (Paid/Unpaid/Academic Credit)
   - Location and Number of Positions
   - Application Deadline
6. Review and submit for approval
7. Admin will review and approve within 48 hours
8. Once approved, internship is visible to students
9. Manage applications from your dashboard
followup: How long does approval take?
What if I need to edit my posting?

faqs.question: How do I register for an event?
faqs.answer:
To register for an event:
1. Log in to your account
2. Go to the 'Events' section
3. Browse upcoming events
4. Filter by type (Seminar, Workshop, Hackathon, etc.)
5. Click on an event to view details
6. Review date, time, venue, and capacity
7. Click 'Register Now'
8. If paid: Complete payment via Credit Card, JazzCash, or EasyPaisa
9. If free: Registration is instant
10. You'll receive a confirmation email
11. Get your QR code ticket
12. Show QR code at the event for entry
followup: What payment methods are accepted?
Can I cancel my registration?

faqs.question: How does QR code ticketing work?
faqs.answer:
QR code ticketing works as follows:
1. After registration, you receive a unique QR code
2. QR code is available in your tickets section
3. You can view/download the QR code ticket
4. At the event, organizers scan your QR code
5. System instantly verifies your registration
6. Your attendance is automatically marked
7. QR codes are unique and cannot be shared
8. Each QR code is valid for single entry only
9. Prevents duplicate scanning
10. Real-time attendance tracking for organizers
followup: What if I lose my QR code?
Can I get a replacement?

faqs.question: How do I volunteer for events?
faqs.answer:
To volunteer for events:
1. Go to the 'Events' section
2. Look for events with 'Volunteers Needed' tag
3. Click on the event
4. Select 'Register as Volunteer'
5. Choose your preferred role (Registration, Logistics, etc.)
6. Select your availability/shift
7. Submit your volunteer application
8. Event organizer will review and confirm
9. You'll receive a volunteer confirmation
10. Complete volunteer training before event
11. Track your volunteer hours
12. Receive volunteer certificate upon completion
followup: Do volunteers get certificates?
What are volunteer responsibilities?

faqs.question: What are the community guidelines?
faqs.answer:
Community guidelines:
1. Be respectful to all members
2. No spam or promotional content
3. No harassment or hate speech
4. No discrimination of any kind
5. Report inappropriate content to moderators
6. Post original content or give proper attribution
7. Help others with their questions
8. Stay on topic in discussions
9. First violation: Warning
10. Second violation: Temporary suspension
11. Repeated violations: Permanent ban
12. Moderators have final authority

faqs.question: What is the Inquisitors Society?
faqs.answer:
The Inquisitors Society is a student-run society at the University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore. We are dedicated to:
- Fostering technical excellence
- Professional development
- Community engagement
- Organizing technical events and workshops
- Conducting conferences and seminars
- Facilitating competitions
- Arranging industrial tours
- Career development programs
- Leadership activities
- CSS and IELTS sessions
- Mock interviews and weekly discussions
followup: How do I become a member?
What events do you organize?

faqs.question: How do I become a member of Inquisitors Society?
faqs.answer:
To become a member:
1. All UET Lahore students are eligible for free membership
2. External members pay a nominal registration fee
3. Register on the platform with your university email
4. Complete your profile
5. Membership is renewed annually
6. Benefits include:
   - Access to all courses
   - Event participation
   - Internship opportunities
   - Community forums
   - Career development tools
   - Certificates and recognition
7. Alumni members have limited access

We accept the following payment methods:

faqs.question: What are the technical requirements?
faqs.answer:
Technical requirements:
1. Web Browsers:
   - Chrome (latest)
   - Firefox (latest)
   - Safari (latest)
   - Edge (latest)
2. Operating Systems:
   - Windows 10+
   - macOS 10.15+
   - Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+)
3. Internet:
   - Minimum 2 Mbps for 3D features
   - 5 Mbps recommended for live sessions
4. JavaScript must be enabled
5. Modern browser with WebGL support for 3D
6. Mobile responsive for all devices
